latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of face-forge CLI skill for AI face morph and face swap.
- Supports text prompt generation and transformation of portraits with optional reference images.
- Integrates with weshop-cli and requires the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Offers two models (jimeng and nano) with various image size and aspect ratio options.
- Outputs results with status and generated image URLs.
